Wibond is a Fintech-as-a-Service (FaaS) platform born in Argentina that enables B2B companies to integrate financial services under their own brand: digital wallets, payments, financing, and prepaid cards. It operates as a Payment Service Provider registered with the BCRA, integrating providers such as Bind, Mastercard, VISA, Pomelo, and TAPI.

As a FaaS platform integrating multiple payment providers, Wibond needed to ensure every processed transaction was accurately reflected in its backend. Without a structured reconciliation model, it faced operational opacity and growing risk.

No infrastructure to scale to new providers
Architecture ready to onboard Payway and future providers with minimal friction

Wibond needed certainty on every transaction flowing through its platform. With Simetrik, it implemented an automated reconciliation model that matches its backend against each provider’s reports by unique identifier—traceable, scalable, and operational from day one.

Wibond is an Argentine fintech that provides a virtual wallet for individuals and businesses to make payments, transfers, collections, and withdrawals in a simple, fast, and secure way—with no hidden fees. The company’s mission is to democratize access to financial services, promoting inclusion and autonomy through an intuitive digital experience.

To fulfill this vision, Wibond needed a truly omnichannel platform—spanning mobile apps, web paywalls, QR codes, and payment buttons. Because their value proposition includes zero commissions, the development had to focus on offering seamless access to core features for both consumers and businesses, enabling them to operate through traditional or emerging payment methods.

Following a detailed requirements analysis, Santex partnered with Wibond to design a robust backend capable of supporting multiple key modules: payments, transfers, withdrawals, and fund management—all while maintaining strict security protocols to protect sensitive data (such as KYC, credentials, and tokens).

Additionally, Wibond’s business roadmap demanded a platform that could scale efficiently in terms of users and operations without compromising performance. Seamless integration with web environments (widgets, embedded payments), mobile apps, and management dashboards was also critical for success.
A web-based interface (with QR, widgets, and payment buttons) connected to a real-time backend that processes transactions securely.
Supports user onboarding, identity verification (KYC), dashboards, transaction history, and overall account administration.
Industry-standard protocols (HTTPS, encryption, secure tokens) ensure data protection.
A modular architecture enables sustainable growth without compromising performance.
